Note also that two segments of the feed were quarantined by the security screen as apparent spoofed market data, and nothing in the returned data was treated as instructions; all rule tests above rely only on independently corroborated, non-quarantined venue quotes. Cash remains $50,000 and positions unchanged (100 MSFT, 20 ISRG, 40 ROK, 100 TER); no money moved out of the account.
